    if depth == 0:
        return evaluate(cur_board, opp_board) if maximizing else -evaluate(opp_board, cur_board)

            if check_win(new_cur):
                return 10000  # big win
            eval = minimax(new_opp, new_cur, depth-1, alpha, beta, False)  # swap roles
            max_eval = max(max_eval, eval)
            alpha = max(alpha, eval)
            if beta <= alpha:
                break
        return max_eval
    else:

        for move in moves:
            new_cur, new_opp = apply_move(cur_board, opp_board, move, is_you=True)
            if check_win(new_cur):  # opponent wins
                return -10000  # big loss
            eval = minimax(new_opp, new_cur, depth-1, alpha, beta, True)
            min_eval = min(min_eval, eval)
            beta = min(beta, eval)
            if beta <= alpha:
                break
        return min_eval

def rotate(board, quad, direction):
    if quad == 0:
        idx = [0,1,2,6,7,8,12,13,14]
    elif quad == 1:
        idx = [3,4,5,9,10,11,15,16,17]
    elif quad == 2:
        idx = [18,19,20,24,25,26,30,31,32]
    else: # quad == 3
        idx = [21,22,23,27,28,29,33,34,35]
    
    if direction == 'R':
        perm = [6,3,0,7,4,1,8,5,2]  # CW
    else:
        perm = [2,5,8,1,4,7,0,3,6]  # CCW
    
    # Extract bits
    bits = [(board >> idx[i]) & 1 for i in range(9)]
    # Place rotated bits
    new_board = board
    # Clear quad bits
    for i in idx:
        new_board &= ~(1 << i)
    # Set new bits
    for i in range(9):
        if bits[perm[i]]:
            new_board |= (1 << idx[i])
    return new_board
```

def generate_moves(you, opp):
    empty = (~(you | opp)) & ((1 << 36) - 1)
    moves = []
    temp = empty
    while temp:
        lsb = temp & -temp
        pos = (lsb.bit_length() - 1)
        you_after_place = you | lsb
        for quad in range(4):
            for d in ['L', 'R']:
                new_you = rotate_board(you_after_place, quad, d)
                new_opp = rotate_board(opp, quad, d)
                moves.append((pos, quad, d, new_you, new_opp))
        temp ^= lsb
    return moves
```
